title: Orientation sign of an IMRep along a bi-Lipschitz piece (supplied step 3, B2′)
statement: Assume (IMC). (IMC) is the exact frozen type of the accepted Submission.cmc_imRep_locality_restrict_sub, the conjunction of: (a) locality of approximate tangent spaces: for U ⊆ ℝ^P open and Borel M ⊆ M' ⊆ U with Hⁿ(M' ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U, for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ M and every subspace Q, HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q ↔ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M' x Q; (b) restriction: for U open, an IMRep R in U and a Borel set E there are a current A ∈ 𝒟_n(U) and an IMRep R' with R'.Represents A, R'.carrier = R.carrier ∩ E, R'.mult = R.mult, R'.orient = R.orient; (c) A − B is integer multiplicity if A, B are (U open); (d) for every IMRep R, for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ R.carrier and every n-covector α, |R.orient x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α. Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open and R an IMRep in U of dimension n with carrier M and orientation ξ. Let G : ℝⁿ → ℝ^P be L-Lipschitz (L ∈ ℝ≥0), A ⊆ ℝⁿ Borel and m > 0 with m|a − a'| ≤ |G(a) − G(a')| for a, a' ∈ A; assume G is differentiable with injective derivative at every point of A and G(A) ⊆ M. Then there is a measurable s : ℝⁿ → ℤ with s(u) ∈ {1, −1} for every u such that, for λ-a.e. u ∈ A and every n-covector α on ℝ^P, J_G(u)·ξ(G(u))(α) = s(u)·α(DG(u)e_0, …, DG(u)e_{n−1}), where e_a := EuclideanSpace.single a 1 and J_G(u) := √det(⟨DG(u)e_a, DG(u)e_b⟩)_{a,b}.
lean_statement: ((∀ (P n : ℕ) (U M M' : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet M → MeasurableSet M' → M ⊆ M' → M' ⊆ U → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[n] (M' ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict M), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q ↔ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M' x Q) ∧ (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (E : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet E → ∃ (A : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R' : IMRep U n), R'.Represents A ∧ R'.carrier = R.carrier ∩ E ∧ R'.mult = R.mult ∧ R'.orient = R.orient) ∧ (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (A B : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → IsIntegerMultiplicity A → IsIntegerMultiplicity B → IsIntegerMultiplicity (A - B)) ∧ (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n), ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict R.carrier), ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, |R.orient x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α)) → ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (G : Euclid n → Euclid P) (A : Set (Euclid n)) (L : NNReal) (m : ℝ), IsOpen U → LipschitzWith L G → MeasurableSet A → 0 < m → (∀ a ∈ A, ∀ a' ∈ A, m * ‖a - a'‖ ≤ ‖G a - G a'‖) → (∀ a ∈ A, DifferentiableAt ℝ G a ∧ Injective (fderiv ℝ G a)) → G '' A ⊆ R.carrier → ∃ s : Euclid n → ℤ, Measurable s ∧ (∀ u, s u = 1 ∨ s u = -1) ∧ ∀ᵐ u ∂(volume.restrict A), ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun a b : Fin n => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ G u (EuclideanSpace.single a 1)) (fderiv ℝ G u (EuclideanSpace.single b 1)))) * R.orient (G u) α = (s u : ℝ) * α (fun a => fderiv ℝ G u (EuclideanSpace.single a 1))
